description: The Haval H5, also known as the Great Wall Haval H5 and Hover H5 for the first generation model, is a compact sport utility vehicle (SUV) from June 2010 to 2020, and full-size SUV from 2023 produced by the Chinese manufacturer Great Wall Motor. It uses body-on-frame construction, with rear-wheel-drive and selectable four-wheel-drive, and is available with either gasoline or diesel engines.
